import json

# Parse the product details from the earlier get_product_details call
raw = details_result.split("(.venv)")[0].strip()
data = json.loads(raw)
product = data["result"]

# Build the markdown content
lines = [
    "# Product Details: " + product["name"],
    "",
    "**Product ID:** " + product["product_id"],
    "",
    "**Description:** " + product["description"],
    "",
    "## General Information",
    "",
    "| Field | Value |",
    "|---|---|",
    "| **Brand** | " + product["brand"] + " |",
    "| **Category** | " + product["category"] + " |",
    "| **Subcategory** | " + product["subcategory"] + " |",
    "| **Price** | $" + str(product["price"]) + ".00 |",
    "| **Rating** | " + str(product["rating"]) + " / 5 |",
    "| **Review Count** | " + str(product["review_count"]) + " |",
    "",
    "## Specifications",
    "",
    "| Spec | Value |",
    "|---|---|",
]

for key, val in product["specs"].items():
    lines.append("| **" + key.replace("_", " ").title() + "** | " + str(val) + " |")

lines += [
    "",
    "## Stock & Shipping",
    "",
    "| Field | Value |",
    "|---|---|",
    "| **In Stock** | " + str(product["in_stock"]) + " |",
    "| **Stock Quantity** | " + str(product["stock_quantity"]) + " |",
    "| **Shipping Estimate** | " + str(product["shipping_estimate"]) + " |",
    "| **Shipping Days** | " + str(product["shipping_days"]) + " |",
    "| **Backorder Available** | " + str(product["backorder_available"]) + " |",
    "",
    "## Additional Details",
    "",
    "| Field | Value |",
    "|---|---|",
    "| **Gift Wrap Available** | " + str(product["gift_wrap_available"]) + " |",
    "| **Previous Price** | " + str(product["previous_price"]) + " |",
    "| **Variants** | " + str(product["variants"]) + " |",
    "",
    "## Compatibility",
    "",
    "Compatible with the following product IDs:",
    "",
]

for pid in product["compatible_with"]:
    lines.append("- " + pid)

lines.append("")

md_content = "\n".join(lines)
print("Markdown content built, length=" + str(len(md_content)))
print(md_content)
